purpose: Bound the buildout scenario with COUNTY-SOURCED entitlement figures and EMPIRICAL completion rates, replacing any assumed multiplier.

county_entitlement.source: Data_Center_Projects.geojson, RemainingGFA field (county-maintained: Completed campuses correctly read 0)

long_range_plan_headroom.source: LRLU_Developable_Areas.geojson (county Long Range Land Use capacity model)
long_range_plan_headroom.note: The 20 industrial polygons flagged EnvironmentalResource=Yes carry exactly 0 developable acres -- the county zeroes capacity where environmental resources are mapped, upstream in the plan rather than at site review.

empirical_completion_rates.lbnl_source: LBNL Queued Up 2025: 2000-2019 interconnection requests reaching COD by end-2024
empirical_completion_rates.pjm_source: LBNL Ix Queue Data File thru 2025, sheet 25: PJM 83,242 MW operational vs 486,990 MW withdrawn
empirical_completion_rates.MANDATORY_CAVEAT: These are GENERATOR INTERCONNECTION completion rates, not data-center construction rates. They are the only empirical base rates available for 'most approved things do not get built' and must be labelled as analogous, not equivalent.

entitlements_are_long_lived.example: Amazon Wellington South is entitled under REZ1989-0069 (a 1989 rezoning)
entitlements_are_long_lived.implication: Unbuilt entitlement in this county should not be discounted as speculative. Approvals from 1958, 1969, 1985 and 1989 are still producing buildings today.

headline: 81.2% of entitled data-center floor area in the county is unbuilt (69,095,336 of 85,132,982 sq ft), with a further 26.7-40.8M sq ft of industrial capacity in the county's long-range plan. The model's full-buildout total is 6.5x its completed-only total.
